parameters.content:
# README

## Dub.co API Workflow Configuration
| Required | Input Field           | Description                                      |
|----------|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
|?| **`Dub API Key`**     | _API Key for Dub.co integration._                 |
|?| **`Long URL`**               | _The long URL to be shortened._                    |
| | **`Custom Slug`**           | _Slug is the path of shortened URL - default is random 7 characters._               |
|?| **`Project Slug`**                  | _Enter Your Dub project slug, The slug for the project to create links for. E.g. for app.dub.co/acme, the project slug is 'acme'._                   |
| | **`Custom Domain`** | _Custom domain linked to Dub.co._                 |







You'll need to add the details listed above in the "API Auth" node by clicking on it and filling the fields ==>
